Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface WikiQueryPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
WikiQueryAdapter
public interface WikiQueryPort
Outbound port — query the LLM-maintained knowledge wiki for pages and contradictions.

This port exists so that newsletter drafting is fully decoupled from the compilation process. The newsletter service (and any future consumer) queries the wiki through this interface without knowing how pages are compiled, stored, or indexed.

Adapter implementations will live in infrastructure.persistence (Slice W2), backed by pgvector for semantic similarity search. Unit tests inject mock implementations so no persistence or AI calls are made outside the appropriate Spring profiles.

      List<WikiPage> findRelevantPages(String query, int maxResults)
      Find wiki pages relevant to the given natural-language query, ranked by semantic similarity.
      Parameters:
      query - the search query; must not be null or blank
      maxResults - maximum number of pages to return
      Returns:
      matching pages ordered by relevance; empty list if none match

    • recentContradictions

      List<Contradiction> recentContradictions(Instant since)
      Retrieve contradictions detected since the given timestamp, ordered by detection time (most recent first).

      This method powers the "Reversal Watch" newsletter section (Slice W3): regulatory U-turns, walked-back vendor claims, and failed replications surfaced automatically.

      Parameters:
      since - only return contradictions detected at or after this instant
      Returns:
      contradictions ordered by detectedAt descending; empty list if none found
